classes.CANONICAL: Only branch allowed to carry continuation authority.
classes.ACTIVE_EXPERIMENT: Explicitly registered live experiment branch. Never continuation authority by itself.
classes.EVIDENCE_ONLY: Explicit historical/research lineage retained for provenance.
classes.EVIDENCE_ONLY_UNREGISTERED: Observed non-main branch with no active registration. Safe default: never continuation authority.
classes.DELETE_CANDIDATE: Looks disposable by explicit naming rule. Do not delete automatically; review provenance first.

active_experiments.question: Does the preregistered minimal joint+parent mechanical recurrent feedback intervention improve Mage FIT1 reachability/retention and parent/root structural prediction under the matched AR0/AR1 design?
active_experiments.proves_if_closed: A verdict about the exact AR-01 minimal mechanical-feedback intervention on Mage FIT1 under the preregistered design.
does_not_prove: full RigAnything formulation equivalence or superiority
product-wide Geppetto architecture promotion without the explicit promotion transaction

branch_overrides.reason: Lossless RiggingSurfaceIR / V3 evidence lineage; no longer the active continuation experiment.
Demo lineage only; never scientific continuation authority.

invariants: A branch is never active merely because it exists or has a recent commit.
Every ACTIVE_EXPERIMENT branch and gate id must be named by CURRENT_STATE.md.
Source existence is not experimental evidence.
Component evidence is not a full-formulation verdict.
Promotion requires source + tests + evidence/result + CURRENT_STATE + provenance/revocation reconciliation.
